newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus central bank 5yr bond yield at 6.99 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus central bank 5yr bond yield at 6.99 pct.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus on Wednesday said it sold five-year government development bonds worth almost 31 million pounds ($58.8 million) with an average yield of 6.99 percent, from 7 percent at the last auction held on June 12.

The bank said bids totalling 37 million pounds were made for up to 33 million pouns worth of bonds initially put on offer by the central bank. The bank said the bids it accepted totalled 30,995.900 million pounds.
The bonds were priced at par. The average price of competitive bonds accepted was at 100.02 pounds with a 6.99 percent yield.
The lowest price of competitive bids accepted was 99.87 pounds with a 7.03 percent yield, and the highest 100.42 pounds and a yield of 6.90 percent.
The bills are the third tranche of five year development bonds which will be floated on the Cyprus stock exhcange, and have a coupon of seven percent, payable half yearly. ($=0.527 pounds)
